limitations.note: Negating `wfull` fixes the defect, but the patch also suppresses RAM writes during reset, replaces the flag logic, and changes the RAM address width at `DEPTH=1`, none of which the reference fix required.

limitations.quote: The reference fix made the write pointer edge-triggered with the existing active-low asynchronous reset and write enable.
limitations.note: The closest knowledge-base entry described a different FIFO defect: this design's write pointer was already edge-triggered, and the entry did not identify the inverted full check.
